token_resolution.ethereum_basis: Maple Finance official frontend integration documentation identifies the PoolV2 vault-share contract by product name; exact symbol/contract was cross-checked against explorer and CoinGecko metadata.
token_resolution.bridged_basis: Current CoinGecko platform registry and linked chain explorers, cross-checked against Maple deployment announcements where available; each venue query used the exact chain-specific contract/mint, not symbol search.

enumeration.source: GeckoTerminal token-pools API fully paginated by exact chain-specific address through a short terminal page; Pendle Core v2 markets/all fully paginated and filtered by exact Ethereum underlying asset ID.
enumeration.live_venue_count_basis: Swap pools were not execution-tested and carry is_live=null. Pendle liveness is established only from maturity relative to enumeration.as_of.
enumeration.completeness: Complete enumeration of pools returned by the named indexes for every declared deployment and exact chain-specific address, including dust and suspicious pools. This is not proof that an unindexed on-chain pool does not exist.
enumeration.empty_chain_note: Every declared chain is explicitly classified; not-configured is reserved for source/transport failure and is never interpreted as no venue.

methodology.tvl_semantics: tvl_usd is source-reported pool TVL, not executable depth. Values are not summed across overlapping or composable pools to claim exit capacity.
methodology.nav_ratio_note: syrupUSDC is an accruing vault share balanced around its NAV ratio, not 1:1; syrupUSDC fair_value was approximately 1.1855 USDC per share at commission time. Treating its stablecoin pools as 1:1 would misstate balance.
methodology.pendle_note: Pendle markets are enumerated with maturity: 0 live and 6 matured at enumeration.as_of. Matured markets are excluded from current live venue counts; residual TVL is not executable depth.
methodology.slippage_convention: not_applicable: this payload publishes no cost, slippage, ladder, crossing, or score fields. If a future DexTracker cost is added, slippage_bps means total and slippage_bps_debiased means marginal; PegTracker publishes marginal.

distribution.interpretation_guard: Distribution only; no concentration-risk judgement is made.
